record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, multiply chronological positional embeddings by 0.75 before adding them to item vectors. Softer positional influence may improve generalization across short, variable-length histories while preserving chronological order, unlike the regressed reverse-position experiment. Keep position-table parameterization, history truncation, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Use identical scaling during masked-target training and appended-mask inference.

category_rationales.rationale: Scale chronological positional contributions by 0.75 across all four category models to test whether softer positional influence improves generalization. Preserve position IDs, embedding parameterization, histories, backbone, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so masked training and appended-mask inference use identical scaling without checkpoint shape changes.
